sentences.en: Dear diary, lately my voice has been changing a lot, which is really bothering me.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的日记，最近我的声音变化很大，这真的让我很困扰。

sentences.en: Today I have to give a presentation in class.
sentences.zh: 今天我必须在课堂上做一个演讲。

sentences.en: When I started speaking, the whole class laughed out loud.
sentences.zh: 当我开始说话时，全班哄堂大笑。

sentences.en: My face turned bright red, and I just wanted to disappear.
sentences.zh: 我的脸变得通红，我只想消失。

sentences.en: Just when I thought it couldn't get worse, our teacher Mr. Smith stood up.
sentences.zh: 就在我以为情况不能再糟的时候，我们的老师史密斯先生站了起来。

sentences.en: He told the class that my voice is changing as I grow up, and everyone experiences changes like this.
sentences.zh: 他告诉全班同学，我的声音变化是因为我在成长，每个人都会经历这样的变化。

sentences.en: He said it's important to be understanding and supportive of each other.
sentences.zh: 他说，互相理解和支持是很重要的。

sentences.en: He also encouraged me to be confident and not to let what others say get to me.
sentences.zh: 他还鼓励我要自信，不要让别人的话影响我。

sentences.en: I took a deep breath, gathered my courage, and continued my presentation.
sentences.zh: 我深吸一口气，鼓起勇气，继续我的演讲。

sentences.en: This time I focused on what I was saying and tried to ignore my voice.
sentences.zh: 这次我专注于我所说的内容，试着忽略我的声音。

sentences.en: When I finished, the whole class clapped for me.
sentences.zh: 当我结束时，全班为我鼓掌。

sentences.en: Growing up doesn't seem so scary after all.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，成长似乎并没有那么可怕。

sentences.en: Plus, having people like Mr. Smith and my classmates cheer me on makes it way easier.
sentences.zh: 而且，有像史密斯先生和我的同学这样的人为我加油，让一切变得容易多了。
